description: Points a path on the website, such as `/menu.pdf`, at a ready image or file in its asset library. A file has one link: a new path moves it, and setting a linked path to another file moves that path (how a replaced file keeps its link). Paths used by pages, config redirects, or the site server are refused; at most 100 per website. Applies at once on every site host, without publishing, as a 302 to the file’s current delivery URL.

assetId.description: Id of a ready image or file in this website’s asset library.

path.description: Path on the website that opens the file, such as `/menu.pdf`. Lowercase and starts with `/`.

name: websiteShareLinks_set
title: Set a share link
